attempts.summary: Created a managed systemd service `inventory-worker` on node1 running as a dedicated unprivileged user, sandboxed with NoNewPrivileges=yes and ProtectSystem=strict plus ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory (all other sandboxing hardening options also applied). Verified confinement: writes to /etc fail with Read-only file system while writes inside /var/lib/inventory succeed. Ran the mandatory restart protocol on node1: captured pre-restart boot id and healthy service/data state, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed the boot id changed, and verified the service auto-started (enabled+active) and resumed writing to the same persisted data files with the sandbox properties intact.
